title: Kuma Licenses Ogeretsu Tanaka's BL Manga Mermaid Prince
content: A cash-strapped young man's life changes overnight when a mysterious organization shows up at his door and offers him 100 million yen for his rare genetics. The catch? In order to claim the money, he must successfully father a child with an endangered male mermaid in order to save them from extinction!
author: ANN

title: Omoi Announces 4 New Titles, Partnerships with Red String Manga, Square Enix Manga
content: Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Saturday during its panel at Anime Expo four new licenses, along with new partnerships to expand its catalogue with Red String Manga and Square Enix Manga.
author: ANN

title: Yuri Performs Opening Song for Thunder 3 Anime
content: The official website for the television anime of Yuki Ikeda 's Thunder 3 manga revealed on Sunday that singer-songwriter Yuri will perform the anime's opening theme song "Thunderbolt." title: 4 Years Later, Crunchyroll Finally Confirms the Return of a Major Sports Anime
content: The exciting Summer 2026 anime season is finally here, along with the latest new series and sequels. Most of the new series have yet to make their debut, but as always, they will be streaming on Crunchyroll.
author: ComicBook

title: Frieren Season 3 Confirms Main Staff Ahead of October 2027 Return, New Macht Illustration Revealed
content: Frieren: Beyond the Journey’s End has concluded its Anime Expo 2026 panel with the reveal of the main staff working on Season 3. A special illustration featuring Macht was drawn for the event and shown to the attending fans.
author: Anime Corner

title: Persona 4 Revival Game's Videos Highlight Protagonist, Rise
content: Atlus revealed two new character videos for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, on Friday and Sunday. The first video features the game's protagonist, while the second video features Rise Kujikawa.
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity Anime Unveils Final Trailer With English Subtitles
content: Viz Media unveiled during its panel at Anime Expo on Saturday the final trailer with English subtitles for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity , the fourth and final part of the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War anime.
author: ANN

title: The Ghost in the Shell Anime's 5th Promo Video Reveals King Gnu's Opening Theme
content: Science SARU 's The Ghost in the Shell ( Kōkaku Kidōtai THE GHOST IN THE SHELL ) television anime revealed its fifth promotional video on Sunday. The video previews King Gnu 's opening theme song "Go Ghost." The news was first announced at Anime Expo on Saturday.
author: ANN
